tasks.name: Prepare electrical design basis and philosophy
tasks.description: Sets voltage levels, distribution configuration and redundancy, codes (NEC/NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, IEEE, API RP 500/505/540), motor voltage thresholds, emergency/essential power philosophy and owner electrical standards.

needs.info: Owner electrical standards, preferred vendors, safety/NFPA 70E program, reliability expectations, spare philosophy
Project design basis: site location, design life, codes and units, execution strategy
Operating philosophy: continuous vs batch, critical loads that must ride through or restart, sparing (A/B pumps)
Site meteorological data: ambient max/min temperatures, elevation, isokeraunic level, wind, seismic zone

tasks.name: Prepare preliminary electrical load estimate
tasks.description: Estimates total connected and running load (MW/MVA) from the equipment list and factored allowances to size the plant supply and utility request.

needs.info: Preliminary equipment list with driver types and estimated absorbed power for pumps, compressors, air coolers, heaters (fans)
Utility balance: electric vs steam-driven drivers, electric heater duties
Estimated motor ratings for large rotating equipment and packages
Design basis: demand and diversity factors, power factor

tasks.name: Coordinate utility interconnect and power supply
tasks.description: Prepares the interconnection request to the utility, obtains available fault levels and supply options, and agrees point of interconnection, metering and protection requirements.

needs.info: Preliminary power demand: peak MW/MVA, load growth, largest motor start
Utility tariff, existing service agreements, site supply points and owner commercial preferences
Site plan showing property line, access for utility line and substation location
Schedule dates for permanent power required (backfeed date)

tasks.name: Develop configuration options and preliminary key one-line
tasks.description: Screens supply and distribution options (on-site generation vs utility, substation count, voltage levels) and issues a key one-line for the selected option.

needs.info: Utility interconnect requirements: service voltage, fault MVA
Preliminary power demand by area
Preliminary plot plan: unit areas and candidate substation locations
Facility siting constraints for occupied buildings (blast/fire overpressure zones)

tasks.name: Prepare electrical cost estimate inputs
tasks.description: Produces factored then quantity-based electrical quantities and major equipment pricing for the Class 5/4/3 estimates.

needs.info: Key one-line and equipment sizing: number and ratings of transformers, switchgear, MCCs, generators
Load list: number and size of motors
Plot plan dimensions for cable lengths and tray quantities
Budget quotes for major electrical equipment
Estimate basis, WBS, and estimate class requirements

tasks.name: Prepare hazardous area release source list
tasks.description: Identifies release sources, grades of release and ventilation per API RP 500/505 and NFPA 497 using process fluid data.

needs.info: Stream/fluid data: composition, flash point, vapor density, operating P/T, NFPA 497 group and auto-ignition temperature
P&IDs showing release sources: pump seals, flanges, vents, drains, sample points, PSV discharges
Flammable gas dispersion results and fire/gas philosophy where they affect extent
Plot plan and equipment locations, enclosed/ventilated buildings
Owner area classification practice (Division vs Zone)

tasks.name: Prepare hazardous area classification drawings
tasks.description: Draws classified area extents in plan and elevation on the plot plan background and issues them to all disciplines and vendors.

needs.info: Release source list with Class/Division, group, T-code and extents
Plot plan and equipment layout background, elevations from 3D model
Building layouts, HVAC pressurization and ventilation for buildings in or near classified areas
HAZOP actions affecting release sources or vent locations

tasks.name: Size substations and electrical buildings
tasks.description: Develops substation and electrical room arrangements and passes sizes, loads, HVAC and civil requirements to civil/structural.

needs.info: Key one-line and equipment sizing: number of sections, transformer MVA, MCC buckets, UPS/battery sizes
Typical/vendor equipment dimensions, weights, heat dissipation for switchgear, MCC, VFD, UPS
Building siting results: blast rating requirements and minimum distances
Area classification: building location relative to classified areas, pressurization need
Plot plan location and access for substations

tasks.name: Develop electrical load list in SPEL
tasks.description: Keys every electrical consumer into SPEL with rating, voltage, duty, bus assignment and demand factors and maintains it through vendor data.

needs.info: Mechanical equipment list: tags, driver type, rated motor kW/HP, absorbed power, duty (continuous/intermittent/standby)
P&IDs/equipment list: running vs spare equipment (A/B), operating mode cases
Instrument and control system power loads: DCS/SIS/F&G cabinets, analyzer shelters, UPS kVA
Building loads: HVAC units, lighting and small power in buildings, kW and voltage
Package unit electrical loads: lube oil pumps, heaters, fans, control panels with kW and voltage
Heat tracing circuit loads and lighting panel loads

tasks.name: Review P&IDs and assign electrical attributes
tasks.description: Reviews P&IDs for motor tags, MOVs, heat tracing flags, electrical interlocks and local control stations and returns comments.

needs.info: P&IDs IFR/IFD with motor-driven equipment, MOVs, heat tracing and insulation codes, interlocks
Instrument index for motor-related signals (run status, trips, permissives)

tasks.name: Size major electrical equipment
tasks.description: Sizes transformers, switchgear, MCCs, emergency generator, UPS/batteries and capacitor/filter banks from the load list and study results.

needs.info: Load list summary per bus: running/peak kVA, essential/UPS loads
Utility fault levels and preliminary short-circuit and load flow results
UPS-powered control system loads and autonomy requirements
Emergency power requirements: fire water pumps, emergency lighting, F&G, egress

tasks.name: Develop one-line diagrams in SPEL
tasks.description: Draws main and MCC one-line diagrams from the SPEL load list and equipment ratings, with protection and metering.

needs.info: Load list with bus assignments
Equipment ratings and utility interconnect requirements
Relay and metering requirements from protection philosophy

tasks.name: Specify MV switchgear
tasks.description: Writes the specification and datasheets and issues the technical part of the requisition.

needs.info: Equipment ratings and one-line diagrams
Area classification and design basis (ambient, enclosure, standards)
Short-circuit duties at the equipment bus
Owner electrical standards and preferred vendor list
Communication protocol and network architecture for electrical control/monitoring (Modbus TCP/IEC 61850)

tasks.name: Specify power transformers
tasks.description: Writes the specification and datasheets and issues the technical part of the requisition.

needs.info: Equipment ratings and one-line diagrams
Area classification and design basis (ambient, enclosure, standards)
Short-circuit duties at the equipment bus
Owner electrical standards and preferred vendor list

tasks.name: Specify LV switchgear, MCCs and E-houses
tasks.description: Writes the specification and datasheets and issues the technical part of the requisition.

needs.info: Equipment ratings and one-line diagrams
Area classification and design basis (ambient, enclosure, standards)
Short-circuit duties at the equipment bus
Owner electrical standards and preferred vendor list
E-house scope decision and building HVAC requirements
E-house skid/foundation support interface and wind/seismic design data
Communication protocol for intelligent MCC to DCS

tasks.name: Specify VFDs and harmonic mitigation
tasks.description: Writes the specification and datasheets and issues the technical part of the requisition.

needs.info: Equipment ratings and one-line diagrams
Area classification and design basis (ambient, enclosure, standards)
Short-circuit duties at the equipment bus
Owner electrical standards and preferred vendor list
Speed range, torque curve and duty for VFD-driven equipment
Control requirement for variable speed (controlled variable, turndown)

tasks.name: Specify UPS, DC systems and emergency generator
tasks.description: Writes the specification and datasheets and issues the technical part of the requisition.

needs.info: Equipment ratings and one-line diagrams
Area classification and design basis (ambient, enclosure, standards)
Short-circuit duties at the equipment bus
Owner electrical standards and preferred vendor list
Emissions/permit limits for generator (EPA tier) and fire protection for fuel tank
UPS load list and autonomy for DCS/SIS/F&G

tasks.name: Evaluate electrical bids technically
tasks.description: Evaluates vendor proposals against specifications, holds clarification meetings and issues technical recommendations.

needs.info: Quotations with technical data, deviations and exceptions
Bid tabulation package and commercial clarifications
Requisition packages for comparison

tasks.name: Review electrical vendor drawings and data
tasks.description: Reviews vendor GA, schematics, datasheets and test procedures for electrical equipment and returns coded comments; loads certified data into SPEL/ETAP.

needs.info: Vendor drawings: GA, one-lines, schematics, wiring diagrams, nameplates, relay data, impedance test reports
PO and vendor document requirements list (VDRL)

tasks.name: Review motor and package electrical data
tasks.description: Checks motor data sheets and package electrical scope from driven-equipment vendors against the electrical requirements and updates the load list.

needs.info: Motor datasheets from equipment vendors: kW/HP, voltage, FLA, LRC, power factor, efficiency, load/motor inertia, speed-torque curves, accessories
Package electrical scope: package MCC/control panel loads, interface terminals, area certification
Motor and electrical requirements for mechanical specs

tasks.name: Build ETAP model and run load flow study
tasks.description: Builds the ETAP network from SPEL load list and one-lines, runs load flow for normal, contingency and maximum load cases and sets transformer taps.

needs.info: Load list and one-line data exported from SPEL
Utility source data: fault MVA, X/R, voltage range
Equipment ratings and certified impedances
Cable lengths and sizes from cable schedule

tasks.name: Run short-circuit study
tasks.description: Calculates maximum and minimum fault currents per IEEE/ANSI C37 to confirm equipment interrupting and withstand duties.

needs.info: ETAP network model with utility and certified impedances
Certified motor data for motor contribution

tasks.name: Run motor-starting study
tasks.description: Simulates starting of large motors to check voltage dips and acceleration and sets the starting method.

needs.info: ETAP network model
Certified motor data: LRC, inertia, speed-torque curves
Driven equipment load torque curve and inertia, start conditions (valve closed/open)
Restart and re-acceleration requirements after voltage dips

tasks.name: Run harmonic analysis
tasks.description: Models VFD and non-linear loads and checks IEEE 519 compliance at the point of common coupling and buses.

needs.info: ETAP network model and load flow cases
VFD harmonic spectra and front-end type
Utility IEEE 519 limits at point of interconnection

tasks.name: Perform protective relay coordination study
tasks.description: Develops time-current coordination and relay/breaker trip settings from utility interface to motors.

needs.info: ETAP model with short-circuit results
Relay models, CT ratios, breaker trip units, fuse curves (certified)
Certified motor data: FLA, LRC, accelerating time, thermal limit curves
Utility protection settings and requirements at interconnect

tasks.name: Perform arc flash study
tasks.description: Calculates incident energy per IEEE 1584 and NFPA 70E, specifies PPE categories and produces equipment labels.

needs.info: Coordination settings and short-circuit results
Certified equipment data: enclosure type, gaps, electrode configuration
Owner NFPA 70E electrical safety program and labeling standard

tasks.name: Design grounding system
tasks.description: Performs ground grid study (IEEE 80) and designs plant, substation and equipment grounding.

needs.info: Soil resistivity survey data and geotechnical report
SLG fault current and clearing times from short-circuit study
Plot plan and 3D model: equipment, tanks, structures and pipe racks to bond
Foundation and structure layouts for ground rod and embed locations

tasks.name: Design lightning protection
tasks.description: Performs risk assessment (NFPA 780) and designs air terminals and down conductors for buildings and tall structures.

needs.info: Building and structure dimensions and roofing
Tall equipment (columns, stacks, tanks) heights and thicknesses
Grounding layout

tasks.name: Design lighting and small power
tasks.description: Calculates illumination levels (IES) and lays out area, platform, building and emergency/egress lighting and receptacles.

needs.info: 3D model: platforms, ladders, stairs, equipment and valve operating points
Building layouts and room functions; structural steel for fixture supports
Area classification for fixture certification
Egress routes, escape lighting and emergency assembly points

tasks.name: Design electric heat tracing
tasks.description: Designs heat tracing circuits for freeze protection and process temperature maintenance using vendor design software outputs.

needs.info: Line list: lines requiring heat tracing, maintain temperature, max exposure/steam-out temperature, fluid
Isometrics and line lengths, valves, flanges, supports per line
Insulation type and thickness per line
Instrument impulse lines and analyzer sample lines requiring tracing
Area classification T-code for sheath temperature limit

tasks.name: Design cathodic protection
tasks.description: Designs impressed-current or galvanic cathodic protection for buried piping and tank bottoms per NACE/AMPP standards.

needs.info: Buried piping routing, sizes, coating systems
Tank bottom dimensions and coating, release prevention barrier
Soil resistivity and chemistry survey
Grounding layout for interference and isolation

tasks.name: Size cables and build cable schedule in SPEL
tasks.description: Sizes power and control cables for ampacity, voltage drop and short circuit per NEC and creates the cable schedule.

needs.info: Load list and one-lines (from/to, ratings)
Cable route lengths from raceway model
Short-circuit duties and clearing times
Instrument cable requirements sharing electrical trays (segregation levels)

tasks.name: Route raceway, cable tray and duct banks in S3D
tasks.description: Models cable tray, conduit and underground duct banks in S3D and reserves space on racks and structures.

needs.info: 3D model: pipe racks, equipment, platforms, routing corridors
Pipe rack and structure steel (Tekla reference model), underground obstructions
Substation/equipment locations and cable entry
Instrument tray routing and shared tray levels

tasks.name: Define MCC and switchgear interface signals with I&C
tasks.description: Lists hardwired and serial signals between switchgear/MCC and DCS/SIS/ECMS and agrees marshalling and protocol.

needs.info: Control narratives and DCS motor control typicals (start/stop, auto/manual, permissives)
Cause and effect matrix: SIS trips of motors and breakers
ICS architecture and electrical network protocol (Modbus TCP/IEC 61850), marshalling locations
Load list with starter types

tasks.name: Prepare control and interlock schematics
tasks.description: Prepares motor control typicals, elementary diagrams and interlock schematics, including SIS and MOV interfaces.

needs.info: MCC/switchgear interface signal list
Cause and effect matrix and SIF trip actions
MCC/switchgear vendor schematics

tasks.name: Prepare electrical layouts and installation details
tasks.description: Issues electrical equipment layouts, power plans and installation details for construction.

needs.info: Plot plan and 3D model backgrounds
Certified equipment dimensions and cable tray model
Foundation and building drawings

tasks.name: Prepare electrical MTO and bulk requisitions
tasks.description: Takes off bulk materials (cable, tray, conduit, fittings, lighting, grounding, heat tracing) and issues MTO revisions to procurement.

needs.info: Cable schedule lengths and types
Tray model quantities
Lighting, grounding, heat tracing and CP layouts
Bulk agreements, catalog codes and surplus/shortage reports

tasks.name: Design temporary construction power
tasks.description: Sizes and lays out temporary construction power and early backfeed arrangements.

needs.info: Construction power demands: laydown, offices, welding, lighting; path of construction
Utility backfeed date and service arrangements

tasks.name: Seal and issue electrical deliverables IFC
tasks.description: Performs inter-discipline and PE check, seals and issues electrical deliverables IFC.

needs.info: Deliverables register and issue dates
Owner review comments on IFD electrical deliverables
3D model review clash and constructability comments

tasks.name: Witness factory acceptance tests
tasks.description: Witnesses FAT of switchgear, MCCs, E-houses, transformers, VFDs and UPS, including integrated communication tests with the DCS.

needs.info: FAT procedures and reports
DCS/ECMS test simulators for communication FAT
Inspection and test plan, release notes

tasks.name: Answer RFIs and issue field changes
tasks.description: Answers construction RFIs and issues field change notices and revised details.

needs.info: RFIs on electrical installation with markups and photos
Field service reports and vendor answers

tasks.name: Define electrical systems and energization sequence
tasks.description: Defines electrical system/subsystem boundaries, energization sequence and supplies tag lists for completions.

needs.info: Systemization philosophy and turnover sequence
One-lines, load list and cable schedule
Path of construction and CWP boundaries

tasks.name: Support electrical testing, setting and energization
tasks.description: Supports field testing (NETA ATS), relay setting implementation, LOTO and first energization; reviews test records.

needs.info: Electrical ITR results: insulation resistance, hi-pot, relay test, motor solo runs
Relay setting files and arc flash labels
Field service reports for switchgear, VFDs, UPS

tasks.name: Produce as-built electrical records
tasks.description: Incorporates field redlines into SPEL, ETAP and drawings and issues as-built records.

needs.info: As-built redlines: cable lengths, routing, terminations, equipment changes
As-left relay settings

items.name: Electrical design basis and philosophy
items.content: System voltages (utility, 13.8 kV/4.16 kV/480 V/120-208 V), short-circuit design limits, redundancy (main-tie-main), motor voltage by kW range, motor efficiency (NEMA Premium), enclosure, starting philosophy, essential/UPS loads, grounding method (resistance-grounded MV), codes and standards list.

items.name: Motor and electrical requirements for mechanical/vendor specs
items.content: Electrical requirements section for driven-equipment and package specs: motor voltage by size, frequency, enclosure (TEFC/explosion-proof), insulation class, service factor, space heaters, winding RTDs, IEEE 841, VFD-duty requirements, package MCC/panel supply rules, local control station requirements.

items.name: Preliminary power demand estimate
items.content: Connected kW, running kW, peak demand MW/MVA, power factor, essential load MW, largest motor size, growth margin; by unit/area.

items.name: Utility interconnect requirements
items.content: Point of interconnection, service voltage, available three-phase and SLG fault MVA and X/R (max/min), utility protection and metering requirements, revenue metering, power quality limits (IEEE 519), backfeed date, utility-owned vs owner-owned equipment boundary.

items.name: Utility interconnection application and load forecast
items.content: Formal application to utility: forecast demand by year, largest motor, harmonic sources, single-line at POI; supports owner commercial agreement and schedule.

items.name: Preliminary key one-line diagram
items.content: Main substation, transformers (MVA, voltages), MV/LV distribution, number of substations, emergency generator and UPS, selected configuration with rationale.

items.name: Electrical estimate quantities and pricing
items.content: Major equipment list with budget prices, bulk quantities (cable by size, tray, conduit, grounding, lighting fixtures, heat tracing), installation hours basis, by WBS/area.

items.name: Hazardous area release source list
items.content: Per source: equipment/tag, fluid, NFPA 497 group, AIT, temperature class, grade of release, ventilation, Class/Division (or Zone), extent per API RP 500/505 figure reference.

items.name: Hazardous area classification drawings
items.content: Plan and elevation drawings with Class I Div 1/Div 2 (or Zone 0/1/2) boundaries, gas group, temperature class, unclassified buildings, pressurized rooms; issued to all disciplines, vendors and construction.

items.name: Equipment certification requirements by area
items.content: Per area/equipment tag: Class/Division or Zone, gas group, T-code; used by MECH (motors, packages), INST (instruments, junction boxes), CIVL (HVAC), vendors.

items.name: Substation and electrical building requirements to civil
items.content: Building footprint, ceiling height, equipment arrangement, floor loads and equipment weights, cable vault/raised floor/cable entry, doors and maintenance clearances (NEC 110.26), transformer pads, oil containment volumes, fire separation, battery room ventilation, blast rating.

items.name: Electrical building HVAC and pressurization requirements
items.content: Heat dissipation per room (kW) for switchgear, MCC, VFD, UPS, transformers; design temperatures/humidity; battery hydrogen ventilation; positive pressurization and purge per NFPA 496; HVAC power supply needs back to ELEC.

items.name: Prefabricated E-house scope definition
items.content: Decision on stick-built vs E-house, modules, shipping splits, equipment included, skid foundation interface.

items.name: Electrical load list
items.content: Per load: tag, description, P&ID, area, kW/HP, voltage, phases, efficiency, PF, duty, demand factor, bus/MCC assignment, essential/UPS flag, starter type (DOL/RVSS/VFD); summary by bus and switchboard.

items.name: Plant power demand summary to process and owner
items.content: Total electrical demand (normal, peak, essential), per-unit kWh/yr for utility balance and opex; issued to PROC utility balance and OWNR.

items.name: Electrical P&ID review comments
items.content: Markups: missing motor tags, MOV/EOV electrical data, heat tracing notes, start/stop and interlock representation, ESD trip of motors, VFD symbols.

items.name: Electrical equipment ratings
items.content: Transformer MVA, voltage, %Z, cooling; switchgear bus and interrupting ratings; MCC sizes and bucket counts; generator kW/kVA; UPS kVA and battery Ah/autonomy; spare capacity.

items.name: Single-line diagrams
items.content: Main, MV, LV and MCC one-lines: buses, breakers, transformers, feeders, cable references, protection relays (ANSI devices), CTs/PTs, metering, interlocks, normal/tie/standby schemes.

items.name: MV switchgear requisition package
items.content: Specification and datasheets: voltage, continuous/interrupting ratings, arc-resistant construction (IEEE C37.20.7), relays, communication protocol, I/O to DCS/ECMS, testing and documentation requirements.

items.name: Power transformer requisition package
items.content: Specification and datasheets: MVA, voltages, %Z, vector group, OLTC/NLTC, cooling, neutral grounding resistor, oil containment data, losses evaluation basis, testing.

items.name: LV switchgear, MCC and E-house requisition package
items.content: Specification and datasheets: buses, starter schedule (bucket list), intelligent MCC protocol, E-house structure, HVAC, fire detection, internal lighting and shipping splits.

items.name: VFD requisition package
items.content: Specification and datasheets: motor list on VFD, ratings, pulse number/active front end, IEEE 519 limits, bypass, motor compatibility (inverter-duty), DCS interface.

items.name: UPS, DC and generator requisition package
items.content: Specification and datasheets: UPS kVA, autonomy, battery type, DC charger rating, generator kW, fuel and tank autonomy, ATS, NFPA 110 level, emissions tier.

items.name: Electrical technical bid evaluations
items.content: Technical compliance tables, accepted deviations, clarifications, recommended vendor per requisition, technical conditions for PO.

items.name: Electrical vendor document comments
items.content: Coded returns (approved, approved with comments, rejected) with markups on GA, schematics and datasheets.

items.name: Certified electrical equipment data
items.content: Certified transformer %Z/X/R, losses, switchgear dimensions/weights, breaker and relay models, CT ratios, heat loss; keyed into SPEL and ETAP and passed to CIVL for foundations.

items.name: Motor data review comments
items.content: Comments to MECH and vendors on motor voltage, enclosure, area certification, starting capability, space heaters, RTDs, VFD compatibility.

items.name: Certified motor data
items.content: Per motor: rated kW, FLA, LRC, PF and efficiency at load, inertia (motor and load), starting torque, accelerating time; used in SPEL, ETAP motor starting, cable sizing and relay settings.

items.name: Load flow study results
items.content: Bus voltages, branch loading, transformer loading and tap settings, power factor and capacitor needs, losses, for normal and N-1 cases.

items.name: Short-circuit study results
items.content: Momentary and interrupting duties per bus, X/R, SLG fault values, equipment duty check pass/fail; feeds specs, cable sizing (short-circuit withstand) and grounding.

items.name: Motor-starting study results
items.content: Voltage dip at motor and buses, acceleration time, pass/fail per motor, restart/re-acceleration scheme.

items.name: Motor starting method requirements
items.content: Maximum DOL motor size per bus, motors requiring soft starter/VFD/autotransformer, minimum starting torque requirements; returned to MECH and driven-equipment vendors.

items.name: Harmonic study results and filter requirements
items.content: THD/TDD per bus, resonance check, filter or capacitor bank requirements, VFD front-end requirements.

items.name: Protective device coordination study
items.content: TCC curves, coordination per zone, selectivity exceptions, arc-flash reduction (maintenance switch) settings.

items.name: Relay and breaker setting files
items.content: Setting sheets/files per relay and trip unit for loading by the commissioning testing contractor.

items.name: Arc flash study and labels
items.content: Incident energy and arc flash boundary per bus, PPE category, label data file for printing and installation, mitigation recommendations.

items.name: Ground grid study
items.content: Grid resistance, step and touch potentials vs IEEE 80 limits, conductor size, rod quantity.

items.name: Grounding layouts and details
items.content: Ground grid routing, ground wells, equipment/tank/vessel/structure bonding points, embeds in foundations (to CIVL), static grounding details.

items.name: Lightning protection design
items.content: Risk assessment, protected zones, air terminal and down-conductor layouts, bonding to ground grid.

items.name: Lighting and small power layouts
items.content: Fixture types and locations, lux levels, circuiting, lighting panels, photocell/contactor control, convenience/welding receptacles.

items.name: Lighting panel schedules and loads
items.content: Panel schedules: circuits, kW per panel, feeder supply; keyed into load list.

items.name: Heat tracing circuit list and loads
items.content: Per circuit: line number, cable type, W/m, circuit length, breaker, panel, controller, maintain/max temperature; panel loads to load list.

items.name: Heat tracing isometrics and requirements to piping
items.content: Heat tracing isometrics, power connection and end-seal locations, RTD locations, requirements back to piping/insulation (insulation oversize, aluminium tape).

items.name: Heat tracing control and alarm interface to I&C
items.content: Heat trace panel common alarms and monitoring points, communication to DCS.

items.name: Cathodic protection design
items.content: Current requirement calculations, anode beds, rectifiers (AC supply load to load list), test stations, insulating flange locations (to PIPE), cable routing.

items.name: Cable schedule
items.content: Per cable: tag, from/to, voltage, conductors, size, type (MC/TC-ER), length, route/raceway segments, gland size.

items.name: Cable pull cards and terminations
items.content: Pull cards with route segments, terminations and drum assignment for construction and Smart Completions tag load.

items.name: Cable tray routing model
items.content: Tray and conduit routes, sizes, elevations, rack levels reserved, fill; reference for piping clash checks and model reviews.

items.name: Cable tray support loads to civil/structural
items.content: Tray loads per rack level and structure (kg/m), support locations and attachments.

items.name: Underground duct bank and trench layout
items.content: Duct bank routes, sections, manholes, depths and crossings; to CIVL for excavation and drainage coordination.

items.name: MCC and switchgear interface signal list
items.content: Per motor/breaker: run status, trip, available, remote start/stop, SIS trip, VFD speed ref/feedback, kW/current via network; hardwired vs serial; marshalling terminal; for INST I/O list.

items.name: Control and interlock schematics
items.content: Motor control typicals, elementary/interlock diagrams, transfer schemes, ESD interfaces with terminal numbers.

items.name: Electrical layouts and power plans
items.content: Substation/room layouts, outdoor equipment locations, power plans with conduit/tray drops, local control station and motor locations.

items.name: Electrical equipment foundation and embed requirements
items.content: Equipment weights, anchorage, base dimensions, conduit stub-ups and embeds for transformers, switchgear, E-houses, generators; to CIVL.

items.name: Electrical bulk MTO
items.content: Line items with commodity code, size, quantity, contingency, delta vs previous MTO; loaded by hand into Purchasing DB.

items.name: Temporary construction power design
items.content: Temporary service, generators, distribution panels and routing for construction.

items.name: IFC electrical deliverable package
items.content: Sealed IFC one-lines, layouts, schedules, schematics, area classification and details.

items.name: Electrical FAT reports and punch
items.content: FAT acceptance, punch items, open deviations, release for shipment recommendation.

items.name: Electrical RFI responses and field changes
items.content: RFI answers, field change notices, revised sketches, impact on cable schedule and SPEL.

items.name: Electrical energization sequence and system boundaries
items.content: Electrical systems/subsystems marked on one-lines, energization order, permanent power backfeed date.

items.name: Electrical tag and cable lists for completions
items.content: Equipment, cable and circuit tag lists with system assignment, loaded by spreadsheet into Smart Completions for ITRs.

items.name: Energization readiness sign-off
items.content: Engineering sign-off that settings are applied, labels installed, tests accepted, ready to energize.

items.name: As-built electrical records
items.content: As-built SPEL database, ETAP model, one-lines, cable schedule and layouts for handover to owner.
